root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The routed file, relative to its root

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed: `json` strict (no comments, no trailing commas), `jsonc` with comments and trailing commas, `yaml` as a YAML 1.2 stream under the core schema (every document, aliases expanded, `<<` a plain key), `yarnrc` a `.yarnrc.yml` read as `yaml` and kept only through its key allowlist, every auth key (`npmAuthToken`, `npmAuthIdent`) dropped at any depth

doc.description: 0-based document ordinal within the file; JSON has one, 0; a YAML stream 0..n-1

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer of the node; the empty string at the root

key.description: The member key, or null for an array element or the root

depth.description: The root is 1; each child is its parent's depth plus 1

type.description: The node's type as the source wrote it

value.description: A scalar node's value: the string, number or boolean; null for null, an object or an array

lexeme.description: A number's source text, or null for any other type

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break

projection-data--values.description: A row of the derived `data__values` relation
